own_solution.law: Tsiolkovsky rocket equation: vf = u ln(m0/m_final)
assumptions: constant exhaust speed relative to the rocket

notes: Checked R answers: q = 50: 3 ln(3250/850) = 3*1.34117 = 4.02352; q = 190: 3 ln(3390/990) = 3.69264; q = 310: 3 ln(3510/1110) = 3*1.15126 = 3.45377 km/s; all match. The wiring text mentions only the final mass md + q, but the certified numbers correctly add q to the initial mass too. The burn-rate cancellation is correct (no external force). Minimal pairs T2E45/T5A37 and T3A6F/T5460 share 190 kg and differ only in attachment/timing; T23F7 and T357D are declared numeral-free twins. Agrees with pass 1.
